items.title: What the fuck is this?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
UPDATE: 11:33 EDT: it has come to my attention that the image of Piss-Drunk Pete at the top of this post was generated by a six-fingered plagiarism robot and is NOT REAL. This is why I should never write a post when I’m sleep-deprived. Sorry, everyone. I will vow to do better. I still stand behind the other 99% of this post. —Jeff T.

I am now back at home, after having spent four awesome days visiting Daughter Katie and Son-in-Law Norrin. It’s always wonderful to hang out with them both, and we all had a great weekend.

This morning, after a long night of air travel, I’m once again rather burned out and in need of a day to recover — so please forgive me for posting a couple of quick hits. I’ll be back tomorrow with the usual full-length screed. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Bribe the Vote™ — Preznit Fuckwit’s patently illegal scheme to line the pockets anyone who’ll vote for Republicans — rolls on. But his latest ruse is a bit different. This time, he’s giving free money to every , no strings attached. Just remember who did you a solid, when it comes time to pull the lever.

“I’m pleased to announce that over— twenty million seniors on Medicare will soon be receiving a— deposit of nearly one hundred dollars directly into— THEIR bank accounts. Through our— war on fraud, we have already reduced your— Medicare premiums by— $132 per year, which is a record. Now, October premiums will be offset— with these additional funds, and seniors will be— able to use that money— for their healthcare needs.”

Okay, let’s leave aside the fact that Dear Demented Leader is so goddamned illiterate that he can barely read off the cue cards his minders put in front of him, resulting in that weird, halting cadence of his. Let’s talk instead about what he’s doing here.

Look, I’m an and on Medicare. Sure, I’ll take the money. Why not? Who wouldn’t like a ? But let’s be clear about two things. First, Donny isn’t funding this gift by rooting out fraud. There is no fraud to root out. He’s doing it through slight of hand, by robbing Peter to pay Paul, as the saying goes — and even Congressional Republicans think that Donny’s financial hocus-pocus

A Republican congressional aide told Dan Diamond of the Washington Post that lawmakers had been planning to use the fund to help fund several health programs this year, and were taken aback by Trump’s announcement.

Second, ‘almost a hundred’ is nice, for sure, but it’s a drop in the bucket in Donny’s inflationary hellscape. Two tanks of gas, and boom, it’s gone. I hope Dear Leader doesn’t imagine that his almost-a-hundred is going to be a life-altering event for anyone.

Donny wants a cookie for doling out a tiny pittance to you, while at the same time grifting billions off his gullible worshipers. Fuck you, Donny — you don’t get a cookie.

Remember — Donny isn’t doing this out of the goodness of his heart. This isn’t the work of a great humanitarian. This is the desperate act of a losing loser who knows he’s going to fucking lose.

Shut the fuck up, Donny. No one’s reading that shit.

Donny should be thanking his lucky stars right now. He’s too dim to realize that Fox News is doing him a favor by not airing any of his batshit speeches.

Donny’s toxic right now. He’s fucking kryptonite. No Republican running for reelection wants voters to be reminded that this is the idiot who clownfucked the country in an unwinnable don’t-you-dare-call-it-a-war on Iran that’s jacked the price of through the roof.

Fox is actually doing what’s right for the GOP, but all Dear Leader can do is bellyache about how he’s not getting the attention he imagines he deserves.

Boo fucking hoo, dipshit. Maybe try not to

Now what. The fuck. Is this?

On the left is our piss-drunk, power-mad, in-love-with-himself Secretary of Death, Pete Kegstand, a couple-three days ago.

On the right is some fucking asshole.

How does this keep happening? Why does it seem as if these fucksnoots are trying to create their own Turd Reich?

Why does the administration’s iconography look as if it were deliberately copied from a 1930 Nuremberg rally?

Why does the Pocket Nazi, Obergruppenführer Greg Bovino, dress as if he were literally a Nazi in your pocket?

Why does Stephen Miller always look like he’s trying to win a Joseph Goebbels look-alike contest?

How is it that the Space Nazi sieg-heils in exactly the same manner — — as that fucking asshole used to?

Spoiler alert: This is not an accident. It’s not some weird coincidence.

These fascist shit-kazoos are not just Nazi wanna-bees. They’re literal Nazis,

They’re the baddies, and they

Lastly, please indulge me for a moment, and allow me to be a proud father.

Twenty years ago, at the age of fifteen, Daughter Katie started a weekly webcomic about video gaming. She called it Awkward Zombie.

She’s still at it. This morning, Katie posted her . I think that’s a pretty fucking cool accomplishment.

And now, it’s Daily Claudia time.

Today, I want to celebrate Ms Spouse’s friendship with her bestie Kathy, because I love revisiting just how much these two genuinely enjoyed each other’s company.

This next one is outside the Ossining restaurant 3 Westerly Bar and Grill, on July 29, 2021. I’m so fond of it that it’s been the desktop image on my laptop since the day I took it.

This last one is also from 3 Westerly, on August 28, 2025. I know I’ve posted it before, but come on — how fucking awesome is it?

Have a great Monday, everyone. Yes, I know — I ended up writing a full-length post. I didn’t intend to. Shut up.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit: still a moron, still insane, still a loser. Let us count the ways.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Film legend Barbara Stanwyck once famously quipped that her only professional challenge was “finding a way to play my fortieth fallen female in a different way from my thirty-ninth.”

Those of us who spend our lives reporting on the infantile antics of the pants-shittingest piss-baby ever to crap himself raw in the Oval Bordello have a similar issue. With Dear Leader’s firehose of malignant fuckery spraying directly into our faces, twenty-four-seven, how do we keep that shit fresh? How do we find some new angle on the madness, and not repeat ourselves?

“We’re gonna win big, and we’re gonna shove it up their ass.”

Oh, how charming. That was Donny, at a campaign rally last night in Vandalia, Ohio — and he’s closing the deal by promising that will get . How nice!

Donny’s rancid anus-mouth has always been a ticking time bomb — but at least he kind of used to keep it barely civil, . Not any more. His rapidly-advancing dementia has collapsed his cortex to the point where all the filters have gone . Now, you never know how low Donny might go.

So we’ve got that going for us.

“And we will pass— the DEATH penalty for large scale drug dealers, human traffickers, and anyone— who EVER KILLS a police officer, or law enforcement official.”

Again, that was Donny, last night in Ohio — but it could have been any one of his campaign rallies, at any time during the last decade. Donny’s been making the same worn-out promises, over and over — and has followed though on none of them, despite holding majorities in the House and the Senate. How many times has this fucker promised that his glorious health care plan will be ready in two weeks? Same with infrastructure. How many times? I have no idea, because I can’t count that high.

But look at all the cultists standing behind Dear Leader, jumping for joy and pumping their fists as he makes the exact same promise to KILL EVERYONE that he made in 2016. Does MAGA even remember that they’ve been cheering for the same empty words, over and over? I’m guessing — because massive head trauma doesn’t magically cure itself overnight.

So how do you find some new angle to report on that shit? Unfortunately, until someone comes out with a movie about some homie who can no longer form lasting memories, it’s going to be the dude from Memento, .

Oh, and before any of you smart-asses pipes up with, ‘but Uncle Jeff, what about Fifty First Dates,’ let me just point out that no one remembers that flick even exists.

Don’t you love how Donny makes every campaign appearance about himself? Last night’s speech was ostensibly in support of Vivek Ramaswamy — but if you blinked at the wrong time, you missed the nanosecond where Dear Leader mentioned Vivek, before launching back into some incomprehensible Shakespearean soliloquy about

“and just yesterday, Bayer— I love their aspirin, I take an aspirin a day. I don’t know if it works but psychologically I need it. It thins the hell out of your blood, I guess. I don’t know if it works or not but I’ve been doing it for a long time. And here I am making speeches. Bayer— and I LIKE BAYER aspirin. Little, yellow— and I take the big one. You know they want me to go down to the eighty. I take the three-hundred and— eighty six, I don’t know what the hell it is. It's a monster. They said, ‘SIR YOU DON’T NEED THAT!’ I said, do me a favor, I’ve been doing okay for 35 years. Leave me alone.”

But tell me, after sitting through that meandering dollop of dumbfuckery, do you think MAGA even remembers who they’re supposed to be voting for?

Well, just to be a dick about it, I’m going to drop in a meme from Fifty First Dates, and you’re all going to go,

Yeah, I have no fucking clue what that’s about, either. Like you, I’ve never seen Fifty First Dates. That why we keep falling back on Memento.

I’m sorry, what we were even talking about?

Oh yeah, right — Dear Leader’s batshit campaign speech. Sorry, I keep drifting off.

“We will pass the No Invasion of Our Country ACT— prohibiting any future president from ever opening our borders to illegal immigrants again. What? We will pass a truly great healthcare plan.”

Yeah, None of that shit is going to happen. Donny’s nonsensical promise to magically pass legislation he hasn’t been competent enough to have already passed is no different from Donny sitting down with bankers and investors back in 1984 and promising that his planned Atlantic City casinos were going to make everyone rich.

Tell me, how did that work out for everyone who fell for the slick patter of Donny the flim-flam man?

Donny’s just chock-full of bullshit. Always has been, always will be.

The bottom line is that who gives a shit what memes I use to mock the fuckery. All that matters is that Donny is super toxic right now. He’s massively unpopular — even among the GOP — and every time he shows up at one of these shittacular rallies, he just digs himself and his party deeper.

Shoot that shit straight into my veins.

Get out and vote on November 3rd. It’ll ruin Donny’s day. I promise.

After all that, I think we’ve earned ourselves some Daily Claudia. Wouldn’t you agree?

Here’s a trio of Ms Spouse, enjoying a boating excursion on the Hudson River near Rhinebeck, on July 15, 2017.

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This week in stupid: October 3 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: new Mamdani scandal drops

Folks, it’s a well-known fact that New York City has become an unlivable hell-hole ever since that Islamomarxistfascistcommunoterrorist, Zohran Mamdani, took over as Mayor. But let me tell you — you have no idea just how fucking deep the rot goes.

Greg Gutfeld: ‘It’s something that a lot of people aren’t talking about in terms of quality of life issues, and I don’t know if you have photos of what’s going on in that area, but, uh, how overweight the hookers have become. Have you noticed that?’

I have to confess, I didn’t notice. It’s not really my thing, so I’ll have to defer to the obviously extensive expertise of horndogs like Gutfield and Watters.

Just let me say that I didn’t have ‘let’s fat-shame the sex workers’ on my Wingnut Grievance Bingo card.

Tuesday: history, as interpreted by morons

Folks, did any of you have ‘Richard Nixon was framed’ on your Wingnut Grievance Bingo cards?

Of course you didn’t. Everyone agrees Nixon was lawless as fuck. It was his own party that convinced him to resign. I mean, no one would be revisionist enough to believe otherwise, right?

West Virginia Republican Rep. Riley M. Moore: “Richard Nixon was absolutely couped out of office and was framed. All of this was fake.”

What in the world? ‘Nixon was set up by the Deep State’ is such a weird hill to die on. Even Tricky Dick was all-too-happy to confess to every bit of the fucked-up shit he did. His whole deal was, ‘when the president does it, it’s not illegal,’ remember?

Remember how we all laughed at the patently ridiculous notion of a president being above the law?

Yeah, well, no one’s laughing now — so shut the fuck up about how Republican Rep. Riley M. Moore, and just enjoy the fact that your current guy is a Very Special Boy who gets to crime all he wants.

Bro, quit while you’re ahead.

Wednesday: signed, sealed, delivered

This week, Preznit Fuckwit took it upon himself to rename ‘Artificial Intelligence’ to ‘Super Intelligence.’ You see, Donny is basically Humpty Dumpty now, and words mean whatever he wants them to mean.

Oh my god — they typo’d the living shit out of the proclamation. How you do fuck that up? How do you misspell ‘United’ as ‘Unites’?

I mean, obviously Dear Leader is too fucking stupid to notice. The guy who had to be told that ‘dumb’ has a ‘b’ in can’t be expected to actually read whatever his minders put in front of him to sign. But didn’t anyone one in the White House chain of command notice? I swear, it’s morons all the way down.

THANK YOU FOR YOUR LACK OF ATTENTION TO EVERY MATTER.

Someday, the mutant cockroaches who will inherit the planet from us, after Donny turns it into a radioactive cinder, will teach that document in their schools. It’s going to be Exhibit A for How Humanity Blew It.

Thursday: was that wrong?

folks, Ken Paxton — Texas’s ethically-bankrupt Attorney General — wants you to know that it’s unfair of you to claim he let a child predator walk the streets a free man after serving only one day in prison.

‘The criticism has been that I let a child predator out after one day. Well guess what? They served 60 days.”

Got that, you stupid leftist? Ken didn’t just slap the child predator’s wrist once — he slapped it sixty times. Check and mate, you commie. Now leave Ken alone.

Hey, you’ll never guess what: Kenny Korruptionpants is lying his insipid fucking face off. That’s not even how that shit went down. Community Notes, can you give us a quick fact-check?

Paxton’s office initially recommended 1 day in jail for Adam Hoffman after he pled guilty to two misdemeanors in his child sex abuse case. The judge increased it to 60 days. Hoffman served about 30 days and did not have to register as a sex offender.

Got that? It was who wanted Rapey McKiddlyfiddler to serve only one day — and the dude ended up serving only thirty days, not sixty. Ken can’t understand why people are up in arms about it. Seriously, was that wrong?

I tell ya, Ken Paxton has to plead ignorance on this thing. Because if anyone had said anything at all to him when he first became Attorney General that that sort of thing was frowned upon…

Imagine being such a black hole of morality that you can’t understand what all the fuss is over cutting some predator a sweetheart deal that lets him avoid the of prison time he deserves. Dude is a twenty-four-seven corruption factory — and he wants to be Texas’ senator.

Texas, do the rest of the universe a solid on November 3rd, and vote this asshole back into obscurity, where he belongs.

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

Some fucking idiot has a brilliant, can’t-miss plan to turn it all around, and prevent the coming Republican bloodbath at the midterm elections. The fucking idiot is going on the road, doing campaign rallies almost every day between now and November 3.

‘absolutely, you fucking idiot, please do this. The more voters see of you, the more they loathe you. So knock yourself out, homey. Go for it.’

Wait, did I say it was a of Emotional Support Morons? Silly me, I misspoke. The arena was a fucking ghost town. Those are some Republicans down there in Alabama, let me tell you.

The fucking idiot also bragged about how he won the Iraq war in just one day. No, wait, it was two or three weeks. No wait, we’re still there — because we’re apparently staying there. Holy shit, my head hurts just from typing out that last paragraph.

When the speech was over, the fucking idiot high-tailed it out of there without stopping to talk to the press — which means that not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and have us some Daily Claudia.

Here are two from the living room, on April 29, 2023.

And one from the back yard, by the woodshed, on April 4, 2020.

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit takes war advice from the Space Nazi’s Mecha-Hitler bot. Hilarity doesn’t ensue.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Almost my entire yesterday was a nightmarish hellscape of delayed flights, canceled flights, and, on top of that, delayed-and-then-canceled flights. I didn’t get home until well after 2 am.

Right now I am so frazzled and sleep-deprived that there’s no way I can crank out a full-length post — so please forgive me for taking a rare day off.

I’ll be back tomorrow with This Week in Stupid. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

But before I go, I need to do a couple of very quick hits — New shit has come to light, man.

It seems that when Donny was plotting to steal Venezuela’s oil and kidnap its leader, one of his most-trusted advisors was a janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot — but it wasn’t just plagiarism robot, oh no sirree bob. it was Grok, the Space Nazi’s own personal plagiarism robot.

In December 2025, Elon Musk returned to the Oval Office for a clandestine meeting. Trump spent hours asking Grok, Musk’s AI chatbot, questions about his presidency and legacy, according to an official present.

Donny spent literal hours deep in conversation with this abomination. I’ll bet you anything that he eventually forgot he wasn’t talking to a human.

Naturally, Donny’s ego took over, , and he asked Mecha-Hitler if kidnapping Maduro would make him popular.

At the time, Trump was ordering missile strikes against Venezuelan boats he alleged were smuggling drugs into the U.S. He asked Grok how Venezuelans would react if the U.S. captured Maduro. According to the official present, the chatbot responded that Maduro was a repressive and deeply unpopular dictator and that many Venezuelans would likely celebrate his downfall.

Mecha-Hitler told Donny that invading Venezuela was a totes awesome thing to do. That’s what AIs do, tell the user what they want to hear. There’s even a phrase for it: ‘AI Sycophancy.’ And it’s fucking dangerous, especially—

if and when the user can no longer distinguish between genuine affirmation and performative flattery.

Gee, does that sound like anyone we know? Donny’s entire White House runs on people doing performative flattery to manipulate him into doing what the want.

‘Sycophantic AI’ is a thing that software engineers have had to work hard to program out of their AIs, because that shit was causing people to harm themselves —

Litigation against ChatGPT claims that the chatbot systematically validated and amplified the delusions of Stein-Erik Soelberg, contributing to his committing homicide.

It’s just super fucking insane that a demented imbecile in command of a nuclear arsenal is taking war advice from a six-fingered flattery-bot. Leaving Donny alone with an AI is like leaving him alone with Chucky.

What could possibly go wrong?

OK, here’s the other thing I want to highlight — and then, I promise I’m outta here.

He’s gonna fix it. Believe in him ... all the abortion, it’s evil ... I want to see 2 people — Trump and Jesus ... we do not want Muslims taking over...I have horrible thoughts. I don't think they should be here. This isn’t their country ... they need to pack up ande go back where they came from.”

I don’t even know what to say about this, except that it’s a cult — a cult made up of hateful, ignorant morons.

It’s 31 days until the midterms. We need to out-vote these shitheads, and take away their power.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

here are two from the 1980s, taken by Ms Spouse’s bestie Mandi.

Have a great Friday, everyone. My god, I really suck at taking the day off. Look, this one’s only 867 words. that’s like half a day off, so there’s that.

items.title: Let’s all look on in horror as a racist game show host does a racism
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Here’s one sure way to tell that Preznit Fuckwit and his party are panicking about having lost the support of the Hispanic community, four and a half weeks before the mid-term elections: it’s that our racist-in-chief is suddenly pretending to give a shit about brown people.

“So there’s a tunnel, going to— what I think will be the greatest ballroom ever— built? it’s also a tremendous military complex with a drone port on top. it’s— it’s QUITE THE PLACE. And you [here, Donny make accordion hands] literally will be the first group EVER TO ENTER the premises. So be VERY CAREFUL. DON’T FALL OVER THE EDGE, ’cause it’s A LONG WAY DOWN. And only a Hispanic could survive that fall. So I’m not overly worried.”

That was Donny, in the East Room of the White House yesterday, for a hastily-organized dog-and-pony show ostensibly celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month. You’ll notice they held the event on the last day of the month, like the afterthought it was.

So there’s Blabbermouth McChucklefuck, yammering away about the big strong tunnel with tears in its eyes, leading to a ballroom like few thought possible, when the coked-up squirrel scampering about in his head suddenly — and without warning — veers into a racism. But not just racism — it’s a racism he invented on the spot.

I’ve been around racists and racism all my life, and I’ve never heard about this preternatural ability of Hispanics to survive falls. Have you?

No biological or scientific evidence indicates that people of any specific ethnic or racial background can survive a high fall. [1, 2]

Donny is like and had a baby, and then repeatedly dropped it on its head.

This abject imbecile should not be president. It’s a waste of his singular ability to be incoherent as fuck. He should be the host of a game show called Donny Says Shit.

I’m talking about a show where Donny blurts out whatever dumbfuckery pops into his head, and contestants compete to come up with the most logical explanation — and, in this case, our winner is BlueSly user LadyPup.

Trump whisper interpretation: Hispanics survive the fall cuz they gets lots of practice going over the border wall.

Yup, I think that is the most plausible interpretation.

A new poll from the Pew Research Center shows that President Donald Trump is losing support among Hispanic voters as well as the wider Hispanic community, with 70% disapproving of his performance.

It’s a no-brainer. You can’t have state-sponsored thugs rounding up every brown person they see and disappearing them into slave-labor gulags, and expect those same people to give you a thumbs-up and go,

And not one of these act-first-and-think-never morons saw it coming.

Not even the original Nazis were this clueless. There’s no record of Hitler going, ‘what’s up with the Jews, why don’t they like us any more?’

Trump says that his convention had 107 million views and the NFL game that night had 25 million.

Here are the actual Nielsen-based estimates for TV/streaming viewers across Fox News, Newsmax and NewsNation: 3.3 Million Trump Speech

That idiotic Emotional Support Convention that Donny threw for himself a couple week back has been the gift that keeps on coming — .

Question: “Do you think Trump is a bit of a drag?”

Paxton: “To be honest with you, when we did that midterm convention, it dropped our numbers. Everybody’s numbers dropped. Yeah. Not good.”

Yup, it’s true — every person who watched that two-day waste of time came away from it even convinced that Donny and the Republican Party

That includes that Republican Party, and it’s looking like Korrupt Kenny might finally have to stop stealing for a living and get an actual job.

Boo fucking hoo, my dude.

Some days, it’s as if our entire nation’s armed forces were being run by an emotionally-stunted six-year-old boy who broke into his parent’s liquor cabinet and guzzled an entire bottle of gin.

“It’s worth saying again so the fake news understands it. We are no longer the woke department, or the weak department. Simple translation of that — no fatties, no trannies, no beardos, no weirdos, no wimps, no radicals. Just warriors.”

Oh my god, what an asshole.

You’ll notice that Pete didn’t exclude drunks from being in his Big Boy Military.

What I also wonder about Pete is, ? No normal person is this hung up on whatever he imagines ‘masculinity’ to be.

Clearly, he’s over-compensating for some humiliation buried in his past. What was it? Did he get shoved into one too many lockers? Did he get brutally rejected when he asked someone to the prom? Something happened — and now the rest of us have to bear the brunt of Piss-Drunk Pete’s desperate need to prove to the world that he’s not the dweeb that Mary Lou laughed at back in high school.

“Project Meridian will be co-led by three of our nation's best minds: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich.”

I have no idea what Project Meridian is — not do I want to know — but I have a pretty good idea that whatever it is, it’s going to a shittacular disaster, because look at the clucksterfuck of dinguses that Pete’s put in charge of it. Newt Gingrich, Palmer Luckey, and the Space Nazi.

Yeah, now there’s a trio I’d trust — if I were a fucking moron. Or a piss-drunk Secretary of Death — but I repeat myself.

Newtie has no experience in either engineering or warfare,

The Space Nazi is the ketamine-addled visionary behind Forkship One, the spacecraft that will someday ferry all of humanity straight up Uranus.

And Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand is, of course, the buffoonish shit-kadoodle best known for flipping a skateboard up into his own nuts.

That’s right, it’s Daily Claudia Time.

Here are three from our living room on New Year’s Eve, 2021. I think I’ve posted these before — but I don’t care, because Ms Spouse is in them. So, here they are again.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

items.title: Are you smarter than the White House’s new AI chatbot? Let’s find out.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Oh, look — just what no one wanted, needed, or asked for.

At a time when the rest of the world has fallen completely out of love with the idea of letting six-fingered plagiarism robots run wild, here comes the White House, to inflict on us its very own AI chatbot.

“Well, we’re doing one thing. We’re gonna be signing a document at about five o’clock today, and— RENAMING— artificial intelligence, because it’s not artificial. We all agree on that, and we’re gonna be naming it Super Intelligence. Officially renaming it.”

This fucking idiot and his infantile obsession with renaming everything.

Well listen up, everyone. I have an announcement to make, too. I’m also gonna be signing my own document today. I’m going to be officially renaming Donny to President Pants-Shitting Moron.

It has a nice ring to it, doesn’t it?

You know what? We should let the White House’s brand-spanking-new plagiarism robot fact-check that for us.

I don’t answer political commentary or personal insults.If you have a question about a U.S. government service, benefit, or official process, I can help with that.

What do you mean, you won’t respond to personal insults? That’s pretty fucking ironic, given whose White House this is coming from.

I can’t help with insults or comments about anyone’s appearance.If you have a question about a U.S. government service, benefit, or official information, ask that and I’ll help.

Fine, be that way. If you won’t explain what the hell is going on with Dear Leader’s fat, waterlogged head, maybe you’ll confirm a simple fact. Is Donny an adjudicated rapist?

I don’t answer political commentary or legal conclusions about public figures.If you have a question about a U.S. government service, benefit, or official process, ask that and I’ll help.

I only answer questions about U.S. government services and official information.If you have a question about a federal program, benefit, or process, ask that and I can help.

Fuck you, Chatbot. You had the perfect opportunity to respond with, ‘an African or European swallow?’ — and you blew it. Who programmed you?

The average cruising airspeed velocity of an unladen European swallow is roughly 11 meters per second, or 24 miles per hour (39 km/h). style.org +1

The Reference: This famous question comes from the comedy film Monty Python and the Holy Grail, where the Bridgekeeper asks King Arthur about the speed of both European and African swallows • (which are non-migratory and cannot carry coconuts). (E) Interesting Engineering +4

Check and mate, White House Chatbot. Get the fuck out of here.

How out-of-touch and tone-deaf are these Donnyverse fucknuggets? No one needs this useless piece shit. We don’t want any stupid gimmicky chatbots.

We want healthcare. We want affordable gas.

Fix the shit you broke. Then we can talk about plagiarism robots.

Now here’s a question that doesn’t need fact-checking:

Is Missouri Republican Senator Eric Schmitt dumber than a wet carton of dog shit?

The answer is, quite obviously, — and yesterday, he went out of his way to prove it, during Jack Smith’s appearance before the Senate Judiciary Committee.

Check out this smug, smirking asshole.

Senator Eric Schmitt (R-MO) launched a hit on Smith, setting up the idea he was part of a conspiracy with Fulton County, Georgia, district attorney Fani Willis and her colleague Nathan Wade to persecute Trump.

Schmitt asked Smith: “Did you go to an NBA game between the Golden State Warriors and the Atlanta Hawks on February 3, 2024?”

Smith looked confused at the sudden turn in the hearing and asked Schmitt to repeat the question. Once Schmitt did, and asked him if he had ever been to Atlanta during his time as special counsel, Smith answered: “I really don’t think so. It’s possible I flew through the Atlanta airport on the way to Florida, but I do not have a recollection of going to Atlanta. I definitely did not go to a Hawks game. I’m sure of that.”

Seriously, Jack Smith is super confused, and the expression on his face is all, ‘what the fuck are you gibbering about?’

Then Schmitt pounced: “What would you say if I had a series of text messages from your team that said you were in Atlanta at a Warrior/Hawks game on February 3, 2024, the day after Willis and Wade announced their affair?” A staffer briefly flashed a poster board. Then Schmitt said: “I don’t think you know that we have this stuff, so I’ll give you a second to process it so you don’t, you know, perjure yourself.”

Smith said: “[I]f this is the correct basketball game, I recall going to a University of Maryland basketball game where Caitlin Clark was playing right around that time…. You could check if that was the exact date. It was Maryland playing Iowa, I think, February of 2024.”

Senator Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) figured it out. Schmitt was accusing Smith of being in Atlanta at an Atlanta Hawks game, where he could hypothetically have met up with Willis and Wade. In reality, he was in Maryland at a game in which Maryland played the University of Iowa: the Hawkeyes.

Holy shit. Eric Schmitt just wasted everyone’s time because neither he nor anyone on his staff were smart enough to understand that the University of Iowa Hawkeyes

How do you fuck that shit up?

Reading is fundamental, you stupid chowderheads. We all learned that, back in grade school.

That sound you just heard was Schmitt stepping on an infinite series of rakes.

Shut the fuck up, White House Chatbot.

Oh, and here’s the icing on the cake.

Newscasters who reviewed tapes of the games found Smith in the stands at the Maryland game.

“Our investigation developed proof beyond a reasonable doubt that President Trump engaged in serious crimes against our nation. If asked whether to prosecute a former president today, based on the same facts, I would do so regardless of whether that president was a Republican or a Democrat. The charges against President Trump were the result of the evidence. Grand juries in two separate districts reached this conclusion based on his actions in the indictments they returned. Rather than accept his defeat in the 2020 presidential election, President Trump engaged in a criminal scheme to overturn the results and prevent the lawful transfer of power.”

In a world of dumbfucks like Eric Schmitt, be a Jack Smith.

oh hey — it’s time for some Daily Claudia.

here are three photos from the patio. first up, Sunday morning bloody marys and brunch, on May 14, 2017

next, afternoon martinis on a late-winter day, March 6, 2022.

lastly, here’s Ms Spouse, crafting a necklace on June 14, 2022.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone.

items.title: look, you idiots — Preznit Fuckwit isn’t giving you five thousand dollars, okay?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Mad King Donny continues to deteriorate before our very eyes.

Yesterday, sweaty and unsteady on his feet, he shambled into the Oval Bordello, half an hour late for the dog-and-pony show that his minders had set up for him.

Surrounded by his Emotional Support Flunkies, Dear Leader sat down at his Big Boy Resolute Desk and struggled to read from his prepared text.

And, of course, as soon as someone else started speaking, the narcoleptic old fart factory fell fast asleep, and started crop-dusting the room with the pungent aroma of ass music.

The whole event was a clownfucktacular shit-show — or, as we call it around here,

“Because of tariffs, we— are— taking in HUNDREDS of billions of dollars of dollars— of profits. It’s one of the reasons I can offer, if— Republicans win the— HOUSE and Senate. $5,000 to every adult. And we can do it and the Democrats can’t, because the Democrats don't have any income.”

Holy shit. Every word that just seeped from Donny’s rancid anus-mouth is either a fever-swamp fantasy, an outright lie, or just a basic failure to understand how works. It staggers the mind when you consider that this low-wattage fuckwad is in charge of our entire nation’s economy.

A $5,000 payment to every US adult would cost about $1.25 trillion. The government collected $195 billion in customs duties in FY2025. Net tariff revenue turned negative in some months of 2026 due to Supreme Court-ordered refunds. Analyses show tariffs cannot fund it.

Got that? There isn’t enough money to give every adult in America five large. It’s just not there, no matter how many tines Donny clicks his bloated cankles together and wishes it were so.

And it’s just fucking weird that Donny considers money taken in via taxes and tariffs to be . they’re not —

This is a fundamental mistake that all these shit-gibbons who insist that ‘government should be run like a business’ make. Governments are not businesses. The revenues that a government takes in are — — used to provide for the public well-being of its people. profits, for some tinpot fucksnoot like Donny to hoard for his own personal use.

And what’s all this nonsense about ‘Democrats don’t have any income’? There aren’t two treasuries, one for each major political party. There isn’t Republican money and Democratic money. It’s just money.

Not only is it fucking insane that Donny believes this, it’s insane that every worthless scribbler of the corporate-controlled press just sits there and nods their head and goes, ‘well, I guess if Donny says so.’

None of this shit is normal. Is it really too much to ask of our media to stop treating it as if it were?

Donny’s hare-brained schemes are in no way ‘ideas for aiding US consumers’ — they’re the mouth-farts of a panicked idiot who is throwing everything the wall in a desperate attempt to not lose the midterms.

Dear Leader couldn’t give a shit about He only gives a fuck about himself. He just wants to remain in power indefinitely.

Oh, and it’s also fucking against the law to bribe people into voting a certain way. How about reporting on ?

Vote GOP, reject the crazy communists, and get $5k as an additional incentive.

How many times is MAGA going to fall for this shit? They’re now the guy from Mememto. They can no longer form lasting memories.

Here we go again. Every time an election looms, the entire wingnut outrage-industrial complex starts flooding the airwaves with bullshit scare-stories about swarthy brown-skinned migrants walking thousands of miles on foot, just so they can cross our border and fuck our shit.

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) issued a strong warning to a major migrant caravan that crossed into Mexico and was moving north with hopes of reaching the U.S.-Mexico border.

“USBP is closely engaged with its international partners to monitor their movement and any additional developments,” DHS told Fox News in a statement. “[United States Border Patrol] USBP reminds migrants that under the leadership of President Trump and Homeland Secretary Mullin, the border has remained closed and secured for the last 16 months.”

Yeah, like I would believe anything that comes out of the mouths of Marky Two-Names and his racist band of shitweasels at the Department of Homeland Security.

What ever happened to scare tactics like that? Fox News is really falling down on the job here. It’s all so patently ridiculous that even the three-toed freak of nature, Marjorie Sporkfoot Greene, can smell a rat.

We have not seen a caravan headed to the U.S. southern border in several years, why now? Oh yeah, there is an election coming and the GOP needs to scare you into voting because nothing else is working.

She’s not wrong — but please don’t be fooled by MTG’s supposed c It’s all an act. She’s not our friend. Never forget that she spent years promoting this racist garbage, and has never apologized for it.

You would think that the cultists would remember that Sporky and her ilk have been hoodwinking them with this garbage since all the way back in 2018 — but you would think wrong.

Mike Johnson says opposition to data centers “is a Chinese psyop. I really believe that. That’s not a conspiracy theory.”

Mike Johnson can fuck himself straight into the sea. Data centers are a nightmare to live with. They’re noisy. They pollute. They deplete local water supplies. They jack up everyone’s electricity bills, and destroy everyone’s property values.

I have an idea whose time has come: how about every one of these shit-kazoo politicians who claim that data centers are no biggie, be forced to live next to one for a year?

let’s see how they like it.

And now, let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Here are some scans that Ms Spouse’s bestie Mandi sent to me. They’re a little bit low-resolution, but I think you’ll agree that they’re adorable as fuck.

The first two are of Tiny Little Baby Katie and her mom, from July or August, 1991.

This next one, I have no idea where or when Mandi may have taken it. Katie looks to be a teen or near-teen, so I’m guessing it’s from around 2004, give or take.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone.

items.title: What the fuck is this ‘let them eat cake’ bullshit from the White House?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Donny was in his element yesterday. Finally freed from the drudgery of having spent three consecutive days in the company of his Slovenian rent-a-wife, he got to pair off with his beloved Diaper Nurse Natalie, and fly in his Big Boy Emotional Support Airplane, all the way to the President’s Cup golf tournament, where he got to do one of his favorite things in the whole world: stand next to a trophy that wasn’t his, and pretend he won something he didn’t.

And then, right in the middle of it all, here comes Mister Ruin Everything, to shout ‘you’re a fucking pedophile’ straight into Dear Leader’s sweat-streaked, fluorescent tangerine face.

Too bad. So sad. Boo fucking hoo.

“We have the best, uhh, I guess you could say poverty. They talk poverty. We have the best poverty numbers ever in the history of our country.”

There you have it, folks — according to President Fucknut McScramblebrain, we have the poverty. We have poverty like few thought possible. Maybe even the greatest poverty of all time. Big strong poverty with tears in its eyes.

Of course, Dear Leader meant to brag (falsely) about having the poverty — but the demented old fuck can’t any more. The family of raccoons that live inside his head have chewed through too many wires.

Holy shit.

It’s all so eternally fucking exhausting. The relentless stupidity. The bottomless greed. The off-the-charts incompetence.

We’re all suffering from Donny Fatigue right now. Even mainstream Republicans are running from him. Imagine being so corrupt and sleazy that a die-hard loyalist like Cornpone McMushmouth is all

Louisiana Senator John Kennedy: “I don’t think any public official, including President Trump or Kristi Noem or John Kennedy, should spend public money on private ads for themselves ... you can’t spend public money to promote yourself. I may end up with a sombrero on my head, but I also think we ought to have a rule that no politician can have a building named after him while he’s alive.”

Republicans are correct to be distancing themselves from Dear Leader. The midterms are in five weeks, and they have nothing to run on — They haven’t kept a single promise. They’ve not done one thing make the lives of We the People better. What does the GOP have to brag about? ‘At least Dear Leader hasn’t nuked anyone’?

The only trick they have up left up sleeves is penny-ante culture war issues. Transgender ‘mutilization,’ as Dear Leader so incoherently puts it. Furry pilots, of all the stupid things. Commies, commies — everywhere you look.

Yeah, well guess what: voters aren’t taking the bait. They want affordable gas.

“Hey folks. I’m here to talk about Antojitos, but I can’t actually afford it, because gas is so expensive. $4.89 if you pay with cash. $4.99 — that’s five bucks — if you’re paying with credit card. This is the one that kills you, though. It’s costing the average truck driver twelve hundred dollars to fill up a single tank. Now, here’s a thing: you probably don’t fill up diesel, but you know who does? Your truck driver — and what do they have in the back of the truck? Well, all your groceries. And they take that to the grocery store, where you then go and buy — but that gets baked into the price of those groceries. We can’t afford it at the pump, We can’t afford it in our groceries. All that, because of a stupid war we shouldn’t be fighting, that’s raising the price of groceries and so many other things. And we’re paying the price.”

Now, of course, El-Sayed isn’t telling us anything that you or I don’t already know. But that’s a campaign ad — and Abdul is using words small enough for MAGA to understand, when they see this on their TV.

Of course, . Dan had some janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot whip up a vid of him, his wife, and Eric and Lara Trump, supposedly having the time of their lives at Friday’s state dinner for President X at the White House.

Diesel prices soaring to record highs this past week have caused Republican candidates in solid-red parts of the country to call for an end to President Donald Trump’s war with Iran and for a ban on diesel exports, as the issue rattles the party’s MAGA base in a way that few have in this midterm election year.

right now — and here comes Danny Scavs, to remind them that the White House doesn’t give a fuck about any of their stupid little problems. They’re too busy whooping it up.

Chef’s kiss, homey.

Do you know where Donny met Danny? At one of his vermin-infested golf motels, where Scavino was a . For some reason, the two hit it off and Donny plucked Dan from the shitpile of obscurity and made him White House Deputy Chief of Staff. Holy shit — from golf club fetcher to White House bigwig. Donny sure knows how to pick ’em, doesn’t he?

Dan Scavino should be thanking his lucky stars right now, instead of fucking shit up for Dear Leader by posting out-of-touch videos. At the very least, one of the adults in the room should have told him to delete it.

Oh wait, there are no adults in the room. Since everyone in the White House is a few sandwiches short of a fucking brain, there was nobody around to tell Dan, ‘hey, maybe don’t post that shit when diesel is seven bucks a gallon.’

The midterms are five weeks from tomorrow. Let’s all hope for the Donnyverse to keep making things worse for themselves. You know they will —

Hey, what do you say we have us some Daily Claudia?

These two photos were taken four years ago today, at Salinger’s Orchard in Brewster, NY, on September 28, 2022.

Now, I can hear you all asking, ‘Uncle Jeff — why were you taking photos of your wife, shopping?’ Easy answer: Ms Spouse was finally up and out of bed after a brief illness, and I wanted to celebrate that.

You can call me a sentimental old fool, because, frankly, that’s what I am.

And now, here’s a photo that Ms Spouse took on that same date, September 28, 2022.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: rogue nation, moron president
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Donny Convict truly is the worst of us.

he’s a burst trash bag of personality defects. can you think of something that wrong with him? there’s the preening vanity. imagine looking in the mirror, seeing that desiccated piss-mop perched atop your head, and going, ‘oh yeah, I’m really rocking it today.’

then there’s the narcissistic grandiosity, and the overwhelming stupidity.

he’s got fascist tendencies. he’s incapable of ever telling the truth, or admitting mistakes. he’s a cheater. he’s lazy and impulsive, with the attention span of a coked-up squirrel. he’s racist, transphobic, and misogynistic.

he’s delusional, imagining that he’s entitled to all the power, all the money, and all the attention.

it makes no sense for Donny reject Iran’s offer. think about it.

imagine you’re the chief executive of a nation. imagine it’s mere weeks before an election that your party is sure to lose, because you’re fucked your country into a unpopular, unwinnable war that’s raised the price of everything. imagine that the country you’re warring with throws you a lifeline, and offers to restart negotiations.

“I’m rejecting their deal. they want to make a deal where they open the Strait immediately, because they’re losing so badly. you know. you don’t read that, or you don’t see that on the fake news. but we’re winning tremendously. we have total control of the— Hormuz Strait. massive amounts of oil are coming out of the Hormuz Strait. last night we had 29 ships come out. ummmm, they want to make deal, and I think that’s fine. I like making a deal, too. but uhhhhh, I’m not— that deal would not be acceptable. and what they want to do is immediately open the Hormuz Strait. you know why? because they’re dying. you know why they’re dying? they have no money coming in. ’cause they get their money from the Hormuz Strait.”

every word that just seeped out of Donny’s rancid anus-mouth is either an outright lie, a contradiction of the previous sentence, or a big ball of — such as his boast that ‘29 ships’ passed through the Strait last night.

“Live vessel trackers report ships currently underway in the Strait of Hormuz, which is about 2% of the normal prewar daily average of around 60 to 100+ ships.”

look, agreeing to negotiate should be a no-brainer. Donny just had a win dropped right into his lap, and he’s too fucking dumb to realize it.

do you know what would happen to the price of oil, if Dear Leader were to announce that he’s resumed talks with Iran? it would immediately plummet — five weeks before the midterms. think of the boon that would be for Republicans.

but Donny won’t do that, because he has no ability to think strategically — and he’s a sadist who doesn’t care who his victims are, even if it’s his own party. he just truly gets off on being a dick.

Republicans have to be tearing their hair out right now.

boo fucking hoo, dumb-asses.

the GOP should be thanking its lucky stars that Mitch McConnell isn’t alive to see any of this shit happening.

The United States and the European Union on Friday rejected a declaration by member countries of the United Nations that pledged international collaboration and solidarity in preparing for and responding to pandemics.

why reject this? for fuck’s sake, it was a purely symbolic gesture that wasn’t even legally binding. it would cost nothing to agree to it.

The declaration, the product of a high-level U.N. meeting on pandemic preparedness, is largely ceremonial. It is not legally binding, and does not set rules for what countries should do during pandemics. But its universal endorsement would have signaled a powerful expression of global political commitment to the issue.

have we all forgotten that the last global pandemic was only six years ago? no one was prepared for that shit, and look what happened. remember not being able to buy toilet paper?

Donny — no doubt egged on by his whale-head-chainsawing lackey, the Marvelous Mister Measles — wants us to stick our heads back in the sand, so we can be just as unprepared for the pandemic. why? what does Donny even get out of it? is he just being a dick?

oh wait — buried way down in the Times’ reported is the real reason for rejecting the declaration:

The 2023 declaration, which the Biden administration supported, recognized “the need to tackle health inequities and inequalities, within and among countries.”

Joe Biden was in favor of it, which automatically makes it

Donny is such a fucking child.

The Trump administration will move on Monday to sharply scale back fuel-efficiency rules for new cars and light trucks, gutting one of the government’s most significant efforts to reduce gasoline consumption and speed the country’s shift to electric vehicles.

oh, come the fuck on — it’s the . remember when we used to be able to relax on the weekend? remember not hearing from the White House for 72 glorious hours? we don’t get weekends any more. the firehose of fuckery just sprays directly into our faces every second of every minute of every of every week of every month of the year.

every single day these Donnyverse shitweasels wake up and go, ‘how can we fuck shit up today? whose mellow can we harsh? how about refusing to negotiate with Iran? or maybe rejecting a pandemic preparedness declaration? what if we gut clean air rules?’

and then some asshole stands up and goes, ‘no, wait — I’ve got the best one yet! let’s put a baseball stadium in the middle of the pristine wilderness! oh my god, that shit would rule!’

Major League Baseball has approached the Trump administration about hosting a game at a national park, officials from the White House and MLB confirmed Saturday.

The administration has scouted locations in Grand Teton National Park to build a baseball park to host an MLB game, according to two other people familiar with the matter, who spoke on the condition of anonymity because they were not authorized to speak to the media.

it was bad enough that Donny built a human cockfighting ring on the White House’s south lawn, just so he could watch roided-out psychopaths beat each other to a bloody pulp. now he wants to build a baseball park in the middle of .

oh, and you gotta love the way the Washington Post tries to sanewash the notion of fucking up the wilderness so that our sports-addicted president can get his rocks off.

National parks are among the country’s most protected federal lands, and constructing a sports facility at Grand Teton could set a new precedent for the use of vast national park land in the Western United States.

‘could set a new precedent’ is doing a lot of heavy lifting in that paragraph.

we need to remember that our country is not Donny’s personal plaything. he doesn’t own the White House. he doesn’t own the Reflecting Pool — and he sure as shit doesn’t own our nation’s unspoiled wilderness.

speaking of the Reflecting Pool, how about Donny finish what he started there, before bulldozing the Grand Tetons — because it sure as shit looks like Mister Ten-Second Attention Span has completely forgotten about it.

if Dear Leader wants a baseball stadium, let him build one right on top of one of his vermin-infested golf motels.

holy shit, that’s some prime nightmare fuel, right there.

oh good, maybe that will shut Donny the fuck up for a whole day. maybe he and the Diaper Nurse will just quietly sit in the corner and canoodle, while happens all around them.

maybe — — when I sit down at the laptop tomorrow morning to type out the day’s post, I’ll be able to say ‘huh, nothing happened on Sunday. here, enjoy some cat gifs.’

I wouldn’t put any money on that happening, if I were you.

mark my words, fuckery will inevitably be afoot today. you can set your watch to it — and lucky me, I’ll get to tell you all about it tomorrow.

oh look — we’ve finally reached the bottom of the post, and it’s Daily Claudia time.

have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: this week in stupid: September 26 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
as another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

monday: fly the furry skies

“many — listen to this — many airline pilots, flight attendants, and air traffic controllers are part of the furry community. lord help us. it’s terrifying, when you think about it.”

furries. Tuberville is talking about , the subculture of people who get off on dressing up as animals.

according to our hallucinating senator here, there’s an epidemic of cats and dogs piloting aircraft. look, I fly often. I’ve never seen a flight crew dressed up as , have you? of course you haven’t — and neither has Senator You Should Have Worn Your Fucking Helmet, Asshole. but this imaginary issue is what Tommy wants us to be focused on — as if we don’t have enough problems on our plates already.

after getting roundly mocked by the entire world for his dumbfuckery, Terminally-Concussed Tommy did what all dipshits do — he doubled down on the dumbfuck.

I know the deranged Democrats don’t like the fact that I called out the insane FURRY CULTURE this week. But the truth is, there is an ALARMING number of these DERANGED people working in our airline industry. Don’t believe me? Just a few months ago, PILOTS were MEOWING and BARKING at each other over the radio at DCA.

oh my god, these pilots were MEOWING and BARKING. the horror!

The audio of pilots meowing and barking at DCA was a longstanding aviation joke/meme on the emergency guard frequency 121.5, unrelated to furries or any subculture, per reports and pilot accounts.

. it’s a thing pilots and controllers do to blow off steam, because their jobs are stressful as fuck.

this whole ludicrous episode is Peak MAGA. they misunderstand a joke, get all worked up over it for nothing, and then waste everyone’s time by actually standing up in the well of the Senate and expecting us to run around with our hair on fire over bullshit.

are there any actual furry pilots? I don’t know. I don’t care. who gives a fuck? all that matters is that we go up in the air, and we come back down safely. beyond that, I don’t give a shit how anyone is dressed, as long as they do their job.

no one gives cares, Tuberville. we want healthcare. we want gas that doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. fix that shit. then we can worry about your imaginary problems.

maybe our terminally-concussed senator here shouldn’t be flying without a helmet.

tuesday: let them eat

now here’s Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins with an important message for the American consumer: don’t bother her with your problems. .

“if [beef] is too expensive … you can eat chicken, salmon, eggs — there are other great sources of really good protein.”

but now that Dear Leader has clownfucked our once-strong economy straight into the shitter, by imposing incoherent tariffs and blundering into an unwinnable don’t-you-dare-call-it-a-war on Iran, the message from the Donnyverse is now go find something else to eat, fuckface.

wednesday: try growing a personality, bro

“the thing that people miss in modernism, that we take for granted, we have normalcy bias in a certain direction. we consider normal what is actually insane. we consider normal women having unsupervised access to one another — all the time. we consider normal women — like all these things. women having political rule. we consider normal women living unattached from a male, like a husband, like a father, then a husband, for lengthy periods of time. we consider normal — you could fill in the blank with all of these modern feminist outworkings of the original feminist vision.”

holy fuck — that’s a lot of words, just to say ‘I’ve never known the touch of a woman.’

grow a personality, bro. stop being such a whiny little boy. if you treat women like people, instead of imagining that they’re some subservient species that owes you their attention, you’ll do fine. trust me.

thursday: Peak Stupid just got out-peaked

“Xi JinPing refused to put his hand over his heart during the US National Anthem just now.”

oh my god. the stupid on Laura’s post is about ten feet thick. how can we possibly dig our way out of it?

Yes. Because he’s not American.

that’s right, President Xi did exactly what he was supposed to do — — because he’s not an American.

which brings us quite smoothly to—
